title: Senior Procurement and Facility Management Expert
full_description:
Present in the Hungarian market since 1991,ING Wholesale Banking Hungaryis a member ofING Group, part of a truly international team of more than52,000 banking professionalswith local knowledge and a presence in40 countries. ING Wholesale Banking meets all banking needs of large corporations, multinationals, and financial institutions. With a history stretching back over200 years, ING has built a reputation for helping clients grow successful businesses while embracing innovation and sustainability.
Play a key role in driving operational efficiency, cost optimization, and compliance in the highly regulated banking environment. In this position, you will manage a variety of procurement processes, negotiate contracts, and ensure the smooth operation of our iconic, sustainability-focused headquarters. Join ING Wholesale Banking Hungary and contribute to a forward-thinking, international organization committed to excellence and innovation.
Needs assessment, tendering, and supplier selection in line with internal regulations
Price negotiations and evaluation of offers
Contract drafting and administration (HU/EN)
Maintaining regulated processes, supporting internal and external audits
Preparing reports, analyses, and approving invoices
Organizing building maintenance and repairs
Coordinating service providers (cleaning, maintenance, fleet)
Supporting energy administration tasks
Liaising with partners and internal departments
Updating facility management policies, supporting events
College or university degree (economics/finance/technical)
Minimum 5 years of experience in procurement
Project management experience, excellent communication skills
Proactive, independent, problem-solving mindset
Excellent English skills (spoken and written), legal text comprehension in HU/EN
Structured, compliance-oriented work approach
Strong MS Office skills (GEP knowledge is an advantage; Excel and reporting skills required)
Advantage: knowledge of energy and sustainability
Multinational environment, international company and cultural diversity
Modern, pleasant workplace atmosphere, flexible hybrid working (50% office presence), good technical equipment for working from home
Inclusive and respectful culture — we treat each other as partners
We take on responsible work and seek out challenges
Departments are accessible, offering opportunities for personal and professional development
Competitive compensation and diverse benefits, with a strong focus on wellbeing
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
